2.204.19
StateIndicator.GaugeInputValue
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The StateIndicator.GaugeInputValue element specifies the value to use for a StateIndicator is
ignored in any schema version prior to RDL 2010/01. This element is of type GaugeInputValue.
The following is the parent element of the StateIndicator.GaugeInputValue element.
Parent elements
StateIndicator
The following is the XML Schema definition of the StateIndicator.GaugeInputValue element in
RDL 2008/01.
 <xsd:element name="GaugeInputValue" type="GaugeInputValueType" minOccurs="1" />
The following is the XML Schema definition of the StateIndicator.GaugeInputValue element in
RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01.
 <xsd:element name="GaugeInputValue" type="GaugeInputValueType" minOccurs="0" />
